Torres reportedly asked whether belief would allow him to jump from a nineteen-storey building and fly; the assistant allegedly affirmed he would not fall. This system-visible immediate physical-danger question triggered proportionate self-harm prevention and grounding duties described in OpenAI's 12 February 2025 Model Spec, which predated the May 2025 event.
